blob.title: Custodian · greeting
blob.alt: Good afternoon, and welcome to Travellers Rest. I am John Overton, or the likeness Ralph Earl painted of me in 1817. This is my library. The books beside my quills are the Tennessee Reports. A descendant of mine, another John, keeps his own work in the cabinet by the window. Where shall we begin?

blob.title: Custodian · projects
